answer: Resist sybils with bonded vouching: a new identity joins the grove of trust only when an established peer stakes onyx-hard collateral on it, and that bond is slashed if the newcomer is later caught colluding or spamming. Vouchers therefore police whom they admit — one careless sponsor loses real value. A sybil operator can seed identities like wild yarrow, but each needs a distinct bonded sponsor with skin in the game, so attack cost scales linearly with the fleet instead of being free. Trust is paid for, and misplaced trust is forfeited.
